Tender(2017-18) for Medical and Surgical Items
Tuesday, 11 July 2017
8708 Hits
Kasturba Hospital invites e-tender for supply of Medical & Surgical items Group (A -J)
Details can be had from https://www.mgims.ac.in OR Incharge Pharmacist, Medical Store, KHS, Sevagram.
Date of commencement of e-tender release : 7th July 2017
Date of New Empanelment : 7 th July 2017 – 3 rd Aug 2017 (Thereafter Block-in period of 3 days wherein e-tenders will be only received by mail. No new empanelment will be done)
Last date of receipt of e-Tender : 6th August 2017
DEMO for filling supplier Excel sheet : 26th July 2017
Opening of Group D tender (Technical bid): 9th August, 10:00 AM
Demo for Glucometer : 10th August, 3.00PM
Opening of Group D tender (Price bid): 11th August, 10:00 AM
e-mail –
medicalstore@mgims.ac.in
(for enquiry)
